description: Save a new prompt to the user's PromptLikeEngineer library (use when the user asks to keep/save a prompt, or via the save-this prompt). Mark reusable parts as {{variables}}; never include secrets. Saving the same title + content again is a no-op. If the title already exists with different content, call update_prompt instead. Plan limits apply (the error says so).
